qualification: Descriptive reconstruction on exactly the same retained non-tie events for all three providers and all six shown models. Not originally issued-pick performance.
limitations: The retained compact direction rows remain unchanged. Separately restored DraftKings T2 clocks are supplied under restored_draftkings_t2; 80 were acquired retrospectively and 40 contemporaneously. These are earlier retained quotes, not demonstrated latest quotes.
Only retained pick directions are recomputed. Full-precision three-provider common-game probability metrics are unavailable in this compact ledger.
Intervals resample whole weeks with replacement using 5,000 fixed-seed draws. They do not establish prospective advantage or a betting rule.
Threshold contracts are not conditional point forecasts. No shared margin/total mean cohort or executable fee-adjusted P&L is fabricated.
